component.name: EchoPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.baseUrl = "http://10.0.0.159:8080" buildChrome() m.statusTask = createObject("roSGNode", "ApiTask") m.statusTask.observeField("result", "onStatusResult") end sub
sub buildChrome() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 596 bg.color = "0x0D1117FF"
' -- left card: model status ----------------------------- leftCard = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") leftCard.translation = [36, 12] leftCard.width = 580 leftCard.height = 550 leftCard.color = "0x161B22FF"
titleLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") titleLbl.translation = [52, 20] titleLbl.text = "[BOT] ECHO AI" titleLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" titleLbl.color = "0xE6EDF3FF"
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [400, 24] m.statusLbl.text = "Loading..." m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = "0x8B949EFF"
sep = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep.translation = [36, 58] sep.width = 580 sep.height = 2 sep.color = "0x30363DFF"
' stat rows - we'll populate these dynamically m.statLabels = [] statKeys = ["Model", "Status", "Backend", "Context", "Temperature", "Memory entries", "Capabilities"] y = 70 for each k in statKeys keyLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") keyLbl.translation = [52, y] keyLbl.text = k + ":" keyLbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" keyLbl.color = "0x8B949EFF" keyLbl.width = 180
valLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") valLbl.translation = [240, y] valLbl.text = "-" valLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" valLbl.color = "0xE6EDF3FF" valLbl.width = 360
m.statLabels.push(valLbl) y = y + 36 end for
' -- right card: capabilities + memory ------------------ rightCard = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") rightCard.translation = [636, 12] rightCard.width = 608 rightCard.height = 550 rightCard.color = "0x161B22FF"
rightTitle = m.top.createChild("Label") rightTitle.translation = [656, 20] rightTitle.text = "CAPABILITIES & RECENT MEMORY" rightTitle.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" rightTitle.color = "0x58A6FFFF"
sep2 = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep2.translation = [636, 48] sep2.width = 608 sep2.height = 2 sep2.color = "0x30363DFF"
m.capsGroup = m.top.createChild("Group") m.capsGroup.translation = [656, 58] end sub
function load(args as Dynamic) m.statusLbl.text = "* Fetching..." m.statusTask.url = m.baseUrl + "/api/echo/status" end function
sub onStatusResult() data = m.statusTask.result if data = invalid m.statusLbl.text = "X no response" return end if if data.doesExist("error") m.statusLbl.text = "X " + data.error for i = 0 to m.statLabels.count() - 1 m.statLabels[i].text = "-" end for return end if
' populate stat rows vals = [ safeStr(data, "model", safeStr(data, "current_model", "not loaded")), safeStr(data, "status", safeStr(data, "state", "unknown")), safeStr(data, "backend", safeStr(data, "engine", "-")), safeStr(data, "context_length", safeStr(data, "ctx_length", "-")), safeStr(data, "temperature", "-"), safeStr(data, "memory_count", safeStr(data, "memories", "-")), capsString(data) ]
for i = 0 to vals.count() - 1 if i < m.statLabels.count() m.statLabels[i].text = vals[i] if i = 1 ' status row gets colour m.statLabels[1].color = statusColor(vals[1]) end if end if end for
' render capabilities + memory on right panel renderRightPanel(data)
dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() m.statusLbl.text = "Updated " + str(dt.GetHours()).trim() + ":" + rp(dt.GetMinutes()) end sub
sub renderRightPanel(data as Dynamic) while m.capsGroup.getChildCount() > 0 m.capsGroup.removeChildIndex(0) end while
y = 0 ' Capabilities section capsHdr = m.capsGroup.createChild("Label") capsHdr.translation = [0, y] capsHdr.text = "ENABLED CAPABILITIES" capsHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" capsHdr.color = "0x58A6FFFF" y = y + 26
caps = invalid if data.doesExist("capabilities") then caps = data.capabilities if data.doesExist("enabled_capabilities") then caps = data.enabled_capabilities
if type(caps) = "roArray" and caps.count() > 0 for each cap in caps cl = m.capsGroup.createChild("Label") cl.translation = [0, y] cl.text = " OK " + str(cap).trim() cl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" cl.color = "0x3FB950FF" y = y + 26 end for else nc = m.capsGroup.createChild("Label") nc.translation = [0, y] nc.text = " No capability data" nc.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" nc.color = "0x8B949EFF" y = y + 26 end if
' Hooks / extensions section y = y + 12 hooksHdr = m.capsGroup.createChild("Label") hooksHdr.translation = [0, y] hooksHdr.text = "ACTIVE HOOKS" hooksHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" hooksHdr.color = "0x58A6FFFF" y = y + 26
hooks = invalid if data.doesExist("hooks") then hooks = data.hooks if data.doesExist("active_hooks") then hooks = data.active_hooks
if type(hooks) = "roArray" and hooks.count() > 0 for each hook in hooks hl = m.capsGroup.createChild("Label") hl.translation = [0, y] hl.text = " " + str(hook).trim() hl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hl.color = "0xD29922FF" y = y + 24 end for else nh = m.capsGroup.createChild("Label") nh.translation = [0, y] nh.text = " No active hooks" nh.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" nh.color = "0x8B949EFF" end if end sub
function capsString(data as Dynamic) as String caps = invalid if data.doesExist("capabilities") then caps = data.capabilities if type(caps) <> "roArray" then return "-" if caps.count() = 0 then return "none" return str(caps.count()).trim() + " enabled" end function
